items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: Can you think of anything in your saxophone lessons about T.O. with any method book that he used or anything special that he taught you? ... He said, Greg, you're going to make a wonderful saxophone player.

ctx.x: Can you think of anything in your saxophone lessons about T.O. with any method book that he used or anything special that he taught you?
Well, I didn't get that far with T.O. Because T.O. went to, uh, he went to, uh, New York during the time. In fact, I was a kid.

When I went to the other side, he went to the head and there was about a month, I see, here. He went to New York and came back and decided to go back. That's how it was. He did go back. I remember, well, this is the day, he said, well, I'd like to do it well, my boy. He said, Greg, you're going to make a wonderful saxophone player. He said, I'll tell you about it, he said, I am only going to be on here about four more weeks. And he was only about four weeks that he was here. He wasn't in New York. He was living…
